_about: Release lines of identified software that their makers no longer support with security fixes. product is the name product_fingerprints.json identifies. A version is in a release line when it equals series or begins with it followed by anything other than a digit (OpenSSL 1.1.1k and Apache 2.2.34 are in 1.1.1 and 2.2; 2.4 is not in 2.2). end_of_support, when the cited page gives it, is the date it gives for the end of support; a line is reported once that day has passed, and a line listed without a date is already unsupported. Each product cites the maker's own lifecycle page; a line that page does not name as unsupported does not belong here. Distributions sometimes backport fixes to versions they ship, so a finding is a reason to check, not proof of a vulnerability. Add release lines here, not in Go code.
